test_modes.name: BMCR Loopback (bit 0.14)
test_modes.purpose: PHY internal MII / GMII transmit-path → receive-path loopback. Receive circuit isolated from medium; MAC TX_EN must result in RX_DV within 512 BT.

test_modes.name: BMCR Isolate (bit 0.10)
test_modes.purpose: Force MII / GMII data signals to high-impedance for multi-PHY board test or hot-insertion staging.

test_modes.name: BMCR Collision Test (bit 0.7)
test_modes.purpose: Force PHY to assert COL within 512 BT of TX_EN assertion to exercise the half-duplex collision path.

test_modes.name: BMCR Power Down (bit 0.11)
test_modes.purpose: Low-power state; MDIO still responsive — useful for board-level power-sequencing test.

test_modes.name: MS Test Mode (1000BASE-T reg 9.15:13)
test_modes.purpose: 1000BASE-T test modes 1-4: distortion / jitter / waveform / wander measurement at the MDI.

test_modes.name: AutoNeg Restart (BMCR bit 0.9)
test_modes.purpose: Re-run AutoNeg to verify state-machine restart + Base-Page exchange behavior.

test_modes.name: Vendor-specific BIST register
test_modes.purpose: Many silicon PHYs add a built-in self-test mode in registers 16-31 (Clause 22) or vendor-specific MMDs (Clause 45 DEVAD 30-31).

spec_provided_observability.name: BMSR.Link Status (bit 1.2)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Latching-low link-up indication; provides software-readable link state. Clears (re-reads to 0) after a link-down event.

spec_provided_observability.name: BMSR.AutoNeg Complete (bit 1.5)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Indicates AutoNeg has finished and the negotiated speed/duplex is in effect.

spec_provided_observability.name: BMSR.Remote Fault (bit 1.4)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Latching-high remote-fault indication from the link partner (e.g. 100BASE-X far-end fault).

spec_provided_observability.name: BMSR.Jabber Detect (bit 1.1)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Latching-high jabber-detected indication (10BASE-T only — frame too long).

spec_provided_observability.name: ANER (reg 6)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: AutoNeg expansion: Page Received (latching), LP AutoNeg Able, Parallel Detection Fault (latching), Next Page Able.

spec_provided_observability.name: MASTER-SLAVE Status (reg 10)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: 1000BASE-T MS resolution, configuration fault, local + remote receiver status, idle error counter.

spec_provided_observability.name: MII signals at the connector
spec_provided_observability.purpose: TX_CLK, RX_CLK, TXD[3:0], RXD[3:0], TX_EN, RX_DV, TX_ER, RX_ER, CRS, COL all probeable at the Clause-22 mechanical interface.

spec_provided_observability.name: MDIO bus capture
spec_provided_observability.purpose: A logic analyzer on MDC + MDIO can record every C22 / C45 management transaction — supports replaying register accesses.

spec_provided_observability.name: Counters in PHY vendor-specific registers
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Optional but ubiquitous: FCS error count, alignment error count, false-carrier count, late-collision count, excessive-collision count, jabber count, RX_ER count, single + multiple-collision counts.

error_detection_mechanisms: FCS (CRC-32) mismatch — frame discarded, FCS-error counter incremented.
Alignment error — frame ends on a non-octet boundary (RX_DV de-asserts mid-octet).
Runt frame — total octets < 64 B (excluding preamble + SFD).
Giant / jumbo frame — total octets > 1518 B (untagged) or > 1522 B (VLAN-tagged); discarded unless implementation supports jumbo frames.
RX_ER asserted during reception — coding-error counter incremented; frame discarded.
False Carrier (RX_DV = 0, RX_ER = 1, RXD = 1110) — false-carrier-event counter incremented; line activity is not a valid frame.
Collision (half-duplex) — single, multiple, and excessive-collision counters; late-collision counter for collisions detected after 512 BT into the frame.
Jabber (10BASE-T only) — PHY detects a transmission > 25-150 ms and asserts a jabber condition, latching BMSR bit 1.1.
MDIO bus contention — STA + PHY both attempting to drive MDIO during TA (read transaction); recoverable via the high-Z TA bit.
Parallel Detection Fault — AutoNeg expansion register bit set when parallel-detect logic resolves multiple PHY types simultaneously.

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: BMSR bit 1.2 transitions 1→0 (link down) or 0→1 (link up) — many PHYs route this to an open-drain INT# pin.
BMSR bit 1.5 transitions to 1 after AutoNeg finishes.
10BASE-T jabber timer expiration; BMSR bit 1.1 set.
Vendor-specific Energy Efficient Ethernet wake event (Clause 78).
MAC Control sublayer recognises a valid 0x8808 / opcode 0x0001 frame; MAC stalls TX for the indicated pause quanta.
Half-duplex MAC TX FSM aborts after 16 retries — raises a MAC-error indication.
Per-frame error indication from the receive MAC.

loopback_modes_summary.name: Near-end MAC loopback
loopback_modes_summary.scope: MAC TX → MAC RX inside the MAC; PHY not exercised.

loopback_modes_summary.name: PCS loopback (BMCR 0.14)
loopback_modes_summary.scope: MII / GMII TX path → MII / GMII RX path inside the PHY; medium not driven.

loopback_modes_summary.name: PMA / PMD loopback
loopback_modes_summary.scope: Vendor-specific; loops back on the analog side of the PHY (e.g. after the MLT-3 encoder).

loopback_modes_summary.name: External cable loopback
loopback_modes_summary.scope: Physical RJ-45 / fiber loopback plug at the MDI; exercises the entire TX + RX analog chain.

notes: IEEE 802.3-2005 does NOT specify JTAG / scan-chain / on-chip BIST at the protocol level. PHY vendors universally add scan + BIST + I/O voltage trim + impedance trim in vendor-specific register space. The Clause-22 BMCR (Loopback, Isolate, Collision Test, Power Down) and BMSR (Link Status, AutoNeg Complete, Remote Fault, Jabber) provide a minimum standardized observability + controllability surface that every conforming PHY must implement.

test_debug.comma_alignment: Confirm /K28.5/ comma detection establishes code-group sync
test_debug.disparity_check: Verify running disparity errors are flagged
test_debug.config_readback: Read rx_config_reg to confirm negotiated speed/duplex/link
test_debug.an_restart: an_restart re-runs the Clause-37 page exchange
